# Phase 1 — Core Architecture

## Objective

Build the application foundation.

Do not implement business features.

---

## Deliverables

- CLI Bootstrap
- Config Loader
- Logger
- Filesystem Layer
- Base Models
- Base Services
- Utilities

---

## Forbidden

Do NOT implement:

- MySQL
- Templates
- Portfolio Generation
- Website
- Dashboard
- AI

---

## Acceptance Criteria

The application should run

porto --help

porto init

without errors.

Every module must compile.

Every function must have type hints.

Every class must have docstrings.

Generate production-ready code only.
